artworks.title: Landscape with Large Leaves and Three Satyrs
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woodland scene with dense foliage and trees obscuring the horizon. The composition includes large leaves and plant life in the foreground, a body of water in the middle with two partially submerged figures, and detailed, gnarled trees on the right. The style features fine line work and a monochromatic palette, emphasizing texture and contrast. In the distance, trees fade slightly but maintain an intricate look.

artworks.title: Tenaya Canyon from Union Point, Valley of the Yosemite
artworks.medium: albumen silver print mounted on paperboard
artworks.dimensions:
sheet (trimmed to image): 43 x 53.8 cm (16 15/16 x 21 3/16 in.)
mount: 62 x 74.8 cm (24 7/16 x 29 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a rugged landscape with rocky mountains, a valley, and a domed peak in the distance. A dense forest covers steep terrain on the right side of the image. The scene is captured in a photographic style with a monochromatic color palette of sepia tones. Light and shadow play across the natural textures.

artworks.title: Zinnias and a Blue Dish with Lemons
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a glass vase with colorful flowers and a blue-rimmed plate with yellow and pink fruits. A soft background in muted colors complements the bright and warm colors of the flowers and fruits. The vase is positioned slightly right of center, with the plate on the left in the foreground.

artworks.title: Campo San Zanipolo Decorated for the Visit of Pius VI
artworks.medium: pen and dark brown inks with gray wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a grand architectural setting with a multitude of figures gathered around an elaborate building. The architecture features a combination of Renaissance and classical styles, including ornate arches, decorative columns, and a façade with sculptural elements. The scene includes a double staircase with balustrades leading to a central arched entrance. People in detailed attire are gathered on either side of the staircase and spread out across the foreground. The structure conveys a sense of grandeur and ceremony, with architectural details providing depth and perspective.

artworks.title: A Cavalier Lying on the Ground
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue-washed laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a person lying face down on the ground. The person's arms are bent and tucked under their head, with legs spread slightly apart. They are wearing a wide-brimmed hat and loose-fitting clothing, including trousers, a tunic or coat, and pointed shoes. Beside the person is a cane or sword with an ornate hilt. The background is plain and shaded with no discernible features.

artworks.title: An Architectural Wall Design in Honor of Henry IV, the Gallic Hercules
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a heraldic composition featuring mythological figures and decorative elements. The scene includes two large, muscular male figures on either side of a central coat of arms. One figure is dressed in a draped garment and holds a club. The coat of arms is ornate with curving lines, a crowned top, and surrounded by symbols such as fleurs-de-lis. Cherubic figures are depicted around the base engaging with decorative scrollwork, each displaying intricate detailing and expressive poses. Large columns with floral designs support the structure, adding to its grandeur. The illustration is monochromatic with sepia tones, conveying an ancient and elegant feel.

artworks.title: Apollo, Diana, and Time with the Cyclic Vicissitudes of Human Life
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over traces of graphite, incised for transfer on laid paper; laid down
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring mythological figures and a large central sphere. The central round object resembles a globe or celestial body, surrounded by detailed figures personifying celestial beings or deities with ornate headpieces and garments. The figures display dynamic poses and gestures, suggesting movement and interaction. Various symbolic items like a sickle and sceptre are included. The background has cloudy textures, enhancing the mythical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Grotesque Decorations for Wall Panels
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate architectural element with intricate swirling designs, including mythical creatures, floral motifs, and abstract patterns. The left panel features a winged mythical creature and a sitting animal, while the right panel includes a human face along with floral-like motifs. The drawing is detailed with fine lines and hatching, showcasing symmetrical design commonly seen in classical architectural drawings.

artworks.title: An Elaborate Ceiling with Trellises and Seated Figures
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over black chalk, squared in red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate decorative panel design. The artwork features a symmetrically arranged pattern with flowing curves, floral motifs, and elaborate scrollwork in a Rococo style. The central design contains a curved top arch, framed by figures and garlands. Circular motifs and human-like figures decorate the corners. A grid overlay is included in the background.

artworks.title: Facade for a Church with a Sculpture Representing Faith
artworks.medium: pen and gray ink with gray and brown washes over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a neoclassical architectural façade. The image depicts a central entrance with steps leading up to it, surrounded by four columns supporting a pediment adorned with reliefs. In the pediment's center, there is a figurative sculpture of a person holding a cross, flanked by two other figures. The side walls have niches holding classical statues. The composition is symmetrical and detailed, showcasing the classical elements of neoclassical architecture.

artworks.title: The Shepherdess
artworks.medium: pastel on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. James T. Dyke
artworks.description: A shepherd is seated on the ground on the left with a flock of sheep grazing around them. A dog sits beside the shepherd. In the background, the land meets the sky with cloud formations. Trees frame the scene at the sides with green and brown tones. The color palette consists of green, brown, white, and blue tones, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: An Ancient Door in Magdalen College, Oxford
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a Gothic-style doorway set in a stone church or cathedral wall. The image captures an ornate arched entrance with intricate carvings and architectural details. Above the doorway are decorative statues positioned in carved niches. The surrounding stone is old and weathered. To the left, foliage partially obscures some of the wall. Shadows play across the stone surface, indicating the photograph was taken during daytime. The overall tone of the photograph is sepia.

artworks.title: Elderly Man Watching Putti Dissect an Eye
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black chalk, heightened with white, on laid paper; indented with a stylus for transfer
artworks.description: The image shows an older bearded man seated on a bench on the right side, surrounded by five cherubs or angelic children. The older man appears contemplative, with his chin resting on one hand. The cherubs are engaged in various activities around him. Four cherubs are shown on either side of the man, and three are examining a celestial globe on a stone block in the center. The cherubs have curly hair and small wings on their backs and are depicted without clothing. The background features column-like structures, trees, and light shading suggesting an outdoor scene.

artworks.title: Very Slippy Weather
artworks.artist: James Gillray after Rev. John Sneyd
artworks.medium: hand-colored etching and engraving on wove paper

artworks.title: Seated Youth Leaning against an Urn
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper (proof before signature on urn)
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 13.9 x 17.9 cm (5 1/2 x 7 1/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed group scene featuring figures interacting with architectural elements. The composition shows various characters engaged in subtle activities around a large, ornately carved vessel or urn. The urn is adorned with a relief depicting small figures and faces. The scene is intricately rendered with fine lines and cross-hatching, creating depth and texture. The background features stone columns and a crumbling wall. The figures are depicted in various poses, adding movement and interaction. Fine detail work emphasizes textures of clothing, stone, and architecture, showcasing a high level of craftsmanship and attention to detail.

artworks.title: Two Men in Elaborate Costumes
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on light brown laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two sketched figures. One figure, seated and facing slightly sideways with their left arm extended, lacks distinct facial features and has long hair. The figure wears elaborate frills on their clothing. The other figure stands with a hand on their hip, also with long hair and similar attire. The drawing is in grayscale on textured paper, with no distinct background or additional objects. The focus is on the figures' attire and posture.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Man in a Feathered Hat (so-called Self-Portrait)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a man's head and shoulders. His head is slightly turned to the right, with a direct gaze. He has a thick mustache and a defined beard. His hair is textured and curls around his head. He wears a soft hat. The man is dressed in loose-fitting clothing, with a draped garment around his neck. In the upper left corner, there is text that reads "G. CASTILIΩVS GENOVESE. FE."

artworks.title: Bearded Man in a Fur Cap, Facing Left
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the head and part of the upper body of a person in profile, facing to the left. The individual has strong facial features, including a prominent nose and a thick mustache. The face is framed by textured facial hair that covers the jawline and chin. The person's hair is long and flowing from under a large hat. The hat has a fur-like brim and a flat top with notable texture. The individual wears a garment with a patterned collar. In the background, there is intricate line work indicating depth and shading, with no specific objects or elements defined.

artworks.title: Bearded Man with Shadowed Face, Wearing a Scarf and a Plumed Hat
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a head-and-shoulders portrait of a person facing slightly towards the left with their head tilted. The facial features are obscured by detailed etching, with the eyes and mouth faintly discernible. The individual wears a large, feathered hat dominating the upper part of the image, and extended hair or material adds to the texture. They have a shawl or cloth around their neck, with no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, with the inscriptions "Castiglione" and "Genovese" in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Pan and Olympus
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 20.6 x 11.5 cm (8 1/8 x 4 1/2 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical figures in a natural setting. The drawing depicts fantastical creatures, including two humanoid figures with goat-like characteristics, possibly satyrs, one playing a flute-like instrument while the other is present. Below them, two cherubic figures are interacting near a jar from which water is flowing. The background features lush foliage, creating a serene atmosphere. Detailed lines convey the whimsy and tranquility of this mystical scene.

artworks.title: Pan Overcome by Putti
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed close to plate mark): 17.2 x 21.9 cm (6 3/4 x 8 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two angel-like creatures wrestling with a centaur. The scene captures two figures with wings appearing to struggle with the centaur. The drawing features fine lines, intricate shading, and minimal background details suggesting a natural setting with foliage and clouds.

artworks.title: Siren and Triton
artworks.artist: Theodor van Kessel after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythical sea creatures. The drawing features a central figure with a muscular upper body and a serpent-like lower half, holding a female figure with similar traits. Another smaller figure, resembling a cherub, is flying nearby. The scene is set against a backdrop that includes clouds and a partially visible rocky landscape. The figures exhibit dynamic interactions, with the fabric draped around some of them appearing to be caught in the wind. The meticulous crosshatching and detailed line work create a sense of depth and texture.

artworks.title: Standing Peasant
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 15.1 x 11.2 cm (5 15/16 x 4 7/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in a relaxed position with their arms crossed in front of them. The individual is facing slightly to the right, with their head turned towards the viewer. They have pronounced facial features, slightly furrowed brow, loosely curled hair, and are wearing a loose, textured garment. They also wear a loose, brimmed hat and simple footwear. The person appears to be holding a musical instrument in their arms, possibly a string or wind instrument, as its shape is only partially depicted. The background is plain and textured, with simple lines and shading suggestive of foliage or ground lines, but largely undefined.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.9 x 9.6 cm (3 1/8 x 3 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper half of an elderly man in a semi-reclined position, facing to the right. He has a thick beard, curly hair, wide-open eyes, a strong nose, and chin. He is shirtless, with a cloth draping across his shoulder and chest. He holds a large book with several pages, and his hands are visible. The background features a pattern of diagonal lines, giving the impression of a traditional sketch style.
